newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: AIB surges 28 pence after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: AIB surges 28 pence after H1 results.

text.p: Allied Irish Banks Plc surged by 28 pence in morning trade on Thursday following the release of better-than-expected first half results, dealers said.
The share price rose to 623 pence by 0900 GMT against 595 at Wednesday's close.
"The results were much better than expectations and a good performance was recorded across all divisions," one trader said. "I would expect significant upgrades of forecasts after these figures."
Earlier, AIB said pre-tax profits for the six months to June 30, 1997 rose by 20 percent to 242.2 million Irish pounds, well above analysts' expectations which ranged from 228 million to 232 million.
